ends.start: N: 50.162, at the north end of the narrows core, stopping SOUTH of Brown Bay — the bay's embayment opens on the east shore from about 50.163 and its water is not the narrows' cross-section.
ends.end: S: 50.121, stopping before Discovery Passage turns SE and opens into the Menzies Bay embayment (Menzies Bay opens west of the channel from about 50.128, and the passage itself doubles in width south of 50.126).

notes.flood_direction: Flood sets SOUTH through Seymour Narrows — Johnstone Strait toward Campbell River. flood_deg 180 is the CHS IWLS station metadata floodDirection for the Seymour Narrows current station (ebbDirection 0). Seed drawn N->S; the narrows here run almost due north-south, so the refined thalweg's bearing at the anchor is within a few degrees of the flood axis.
notes.spring_max_kn: 15.60 kn — maximum |value| over every EXTREMA_FLOOD/EXTREMA_EBB event in the CHS IWLS wcp1-events series for the whole of 2026 (2821 events), at 2026-06-15T22:15Z on a flood. Matches the 15-16 kn Sailing Directions and the Canadian tide tables give for Seymour. Station resolved by officialName against the IWLS station list, not by a provider-minted id (station-corrections policy).
notes.cd_to_mwl_m: 2.88 m = Mean Water Level above chart datum at the Seymour Narrows TIDE station (IWLS heights, MWL height type) — the same place, so no transfer. Cross-check: Campbell River, 11 km S, reads 2.78 m.
notes.bathymetry: GSC Canada West Coast Topo-Bathymetric DEM, 10 m, version 2 (NRCan, OGL-Canada). Vertical datum CHS chart datum, elevation-up (water negative) -> tile_value "elevation"; both verified, see data/tiles/seymour-narrows/MANIFEST.json. Least depth along the traced thalweg is 76.9 m: Seymour is deep everywhere, and its speed comes from width, not from a sill.
notes.thalweg_seed: Least-cost route (cost 1/depth^2, land impassable) from a point in the channel at 50.162 to one at 50.121, decimated to ~150 m; sections.py's refinement owns the final centreline.
